items.quote: Den Rechnungsbetrag erbitten wir ohne Abzug binnen 10 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 25.11.2026. The period 'binnen 10 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum' is a civil-law deadline counted from an event (the invoice date itself), so under §187(1) BGB the day of the event is excluded and counting starts on 26.11.2026 (day 1). Counting 10 days: 26,27,28,29,30 Nov (days 1-5) and 1,2,3,4,5 Dec (days 6-10) lands on 05.12.2026, which is a Saturday. Under §193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a payment falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it is replaced by the next business day, so the deadline moves to Monday 07.12.2026.
